_readme: Hand-maintained inputs for lib/fetch-signals.mjs. Every entry is either a decision about an automatic match (Form D accept/reject, with the reason) or a candidate that the fetcher verifies over the network before it is used (repositories must exist on GitHub, packages must return download data, announcement and event URLs must answer and must contain the evidence phrase). Nothing here is written into signals.json unverified.
